## Evidence collected

The current public-safe brief reports homepage, robots, and sitemap HTTP 200, canonical `https://eunomia.dev/`, and **818 sitemap entries**. PR `#211` is the latest fully published Daily Report; it has one verified closeout comment. Unmerged attempts are excluded from published-state accounting.

Current libbpf automatic pinned-map reuse compares map type, key/value sizes, `max_entries`, flags, and `map_extra`. Those checks do not prove BTF structural identity or application-level state meaning. Linux BTF provides richer type evidence, while `BPF_OBJ_PIN` extends a live kernel object's lifetime beyond one userspace process.

## Work performed

Selected the eBPF-centered pinned-map state-admission report. The published newest-ten mix is **7 eBPF / 1 Agent / 2 adjacent**, and this publication preserves **7 / 1 / 2**. The report develops BTF-derived structural fingerprints, versioned semantic state/migration contracts, and shadow validation before a new generation receives write authority.

No unrelated technical SEO patch was made because current evidence does not establish a crawlability, canonical, hreflang, structured-data, redirect, broken-link, rendering, accessibility, or persistent-performance defect.
